Appendix D Governing equations

It is often convenient to have all relevant equations available “at a single glance”. We therefore reproduce all governing equations given in previous sections in this appendix together. No gauge is specified, i.e. without choosing a particular hypersurface or gauge restrictions, and we leave quantities undecomposed whenever possible (the decomposition rules are given in Eqs. (2.4), (2.11), and (2.12)).

D.1 Background

Energy conservation for the α\alpha-fluid in the background is given from Eq. (4.21) as

ρ0​α′=−3​ℋ​(ρ0​α+P0​α)+a​Q0​α,\rho_{0\alpha}^{\prime}=-3{\cal H}\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)+aQ_{0\alpha}\,, (4.64)

and the total energy conservation is then given by summing over the individual fluids and using Eq. (4.22) as

ρ0′=−3​ℋ​(ρ0+P0).\rho_{0}^{\prime}=-3{\cal H}\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\,. (4.65)

The Friedmann constraint is given from the 0−00-0 component Eq. (8.1) as

H2=8​π​G3​ρ0ℋ2=8​π​G3​a2​ρ0.H^{2}=\frac{8\pi G}{3}\rho_{0}\qquad{\cal H}^{2}=\frac{8\pi G}{3}a^{2}\rho_{0}\,. (4.66)

The trace gives

a′2a2−2​a′′a=8​π​G​a2​P0.\frac{a^{\prime 2}}{a^{2}}-2\frac{a^{\prime\prime}}{a}=8\pi Ga^{2}P_{0}\,. (4.67)

D.2 First order

In this subsection we give the governing equations on large scales in the general case without any gauge restrictions, i.e. without choosing a particular hypersurface.

D.2.1 Field equations

The 0−00-0 Einstein equation is given from Eq. (8.1) as

3​ℋ​(ℋ​ϕ1+ψ1′)−∇2(ψ1+ℋ​σ1)=−4​π​G​a2​δ​ρ1.3{\cal H}\left({\cal H}\phi_{1}+\psi_{1}^{\prime}\right)-\nabla^{2}\left(\psi_{1}+{\cal H}\sigma_{1}\right)=-4\pi Ga^{2}\delta\rho_{1}\,. (4.68)

The 0−i0-i Einstein equation is

ℋ​ϕ1+ψ1′=−4​π​G​a2​(ρ0+P0)​(v1+B1),{\cal H}\phi_{1}+\psi_{1}^{\prime}=-4\pi Ga^{2}\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left(v_{1}+B_{1}\right)\,, (4.69)

the off-trace is

σ1′+2​ℋ​σ1+ψ1−ϕ1=8​π​G​a2​Π,\sigma_{1}^{\prime}+2{\cal H}\sigma_{1}+\psi_{1}-\phi_{1}=8\pi Ga^{2}\Pi\,, (4.70)

and the trace is

ψ1′′+2​ℋ​ψ1′+ℋ​ϕ1′+(2​a′′a−a′2a2)​ϕ1=4​π​G​a2​(δ​P1+23​∇2Π).\psi_{1}^{\prime\prime}+2{\cal H}\psi_{1}^{\prime}+{\cal H}\phi_{1}^{\prime}+\left(2\frac{a^{\prime\prime}}{a}-\frac{a^{\prime 2}}{a^{2}}\right)\phi_{1}=4\pi Ga^{2}\left(\delta P_{1}+\frac{2}{3}\nabla^{2}\Pi\right)\,. (4.71)

D.2.2 Energy-momentum conservation

Energy and momentum conservation of the α\alpha-fluid is given from Eq. (4.21) at first order as

δ​ρα′+3​ℋ​(δ​ρα+δ​Pα)−3​(ρα+Pα)​ψ′+a−1​(ρα+Pα)​∇2(Vα+σ)=a​Qα​ϕ+a​δ​Qα,\delta\rho_{\alpha}^{\prime}+3{\cal H}(\delta\rho_{\alpha}+\delta P_{\alpha})-3\left(\rho_{\alpha}+P_{\alpha}\right)\psi^{\prime}+a^{-1}(\rho_{\alpha}+P_{\alpha})\nabla^{2}\left({V_{\alpha}}+{\sigma}\right)=aQ_{\alpha}\phi+a\delta Q_{\alpha}\,, (4.72)

The momentum conservation equation of the α\alpha-fluid is

Vα′+[a​Qαρα+Pα​(1+cα2)−3​ℋ​cα2]​Vα+a​ϕ+aρα+Pα​[δ​Pα+23​∇2Πα−Qα​V−fα]=0.{V}_{\alpha}^{\prime}+\left[\frac{aQ_{\alpha}}{\rho_{\alpha}+P_{\alpha}}(1+c^{2}_{\alpha})-3{\cal H}c^{2}_{\alpha}\right]{V_{\alpha}}+a\phi+\frac{a}{\rho_{\alpha}+P_{\alpha}}\left[\delta P_{\alpha}+\frac{2}{3}\nabla^{2}\Pi_{\alpha}-Q_{\alpha}V-f_{\alpha}\right]=0\,. (4.73)

Total energy and momentum conservation follows from the above, by summing over all individual fluids and using Eqs. (4.22), and is given by

δ​ρ1′+3​ℋ​(δ​ρ1+δ​P1)\displaystyle\delta\rho_{1}^{\prime}+3{\cal H}\left({\delta\rho_{1}}+{\delta P_{1}}\right) +\displaystyle+ (ρ0+P0)​[∇2(σ1+v1+B1)−3​ψ1′]=0,\displaystyle\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left[\nabla^{2}\left(\sigma_{1}+v_{1}+B_{1}\right)-3\psi_{1}^{\prime}\right]=0\,, (4.74)
[(ρ0+P0)​(v1+B1)]′\displaystyle\left[\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left(v_{1}+B_{1}\right)\right]^{\prime} +\displaystyle+ (ρ0+P0)​[4​ℋ​(v1+B1)+ϕ1]+δ​P1+23​∇2Π=0.\displaystyle\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left[4{\cal H}\left(v_{1}+B_{1}\right)+\phi_{1}\right]+\delta P_{1}+\frac{2}{3}\nabla^{2}\Pi=0\,.

D.3 Second order

D.3.1 Energy-momentum conservation

In the multi-fluid case, energy conservation of the α\alpha-fluid is given from Eq. (4.21) at second order as

δ​ρ2​α′+3​ℋ​(δ​ρ2​α+δ​P2​α)+(ρ0​α+P0​α)​(−3​ψ2′+∇2E2′+∇2v2​α)\displaystyle\delta\rho_{2\alpha}^{\prime}+3{\cal H}\left({\delta\rho_{2\alpha}}+{\delta P_{2\alpha}}\right)+\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)\left(-3\psi_{2}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}E_{2}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}v_{2\alpha}\right)
+2​(δ​ρ1​α+δ​P1​α)​(−3​ψ1′+∇2E1′+∇2v1​α)\displaystyle+2\left({\delta\rho_{1\alpha}}+{\delta P_{1\alpha}}\right)\left(-3\psi_{1}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}E_{1}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}v_{1\alpha}\right)
+2(δρ1​α+δP1​α),kv1​αk+2(ρ0​α′+P0​α′)v1​αk(v1​(α)​k+B1​k)\displaystyle+2\left({\delta\rho_{1\alpha}}+{\delta P_{1\alpha}}\right)_{,k}v_{1\alpha}^{k}+2\left(\rho_{0\alpha}^{\prime}+P_{0\alpha}^{\prime}\right)v_{1\alpha}^{k}\left(v_{1(\alpha)k}+B_{1k}\right)
+2​(ρ0​α+P0​α)​[(v1​(α)​k′+B1​k′)​(2​v1​(α)​k+B1​k)+4​ℋ​v1​(α)k​(v1​(α)​k+B1​k)]\displaystyle+2\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)\left[\left(v_{1(\alpha)k}^{\prime}+B_{1k}^{\prime}\right)\left(2v_{1(\alpha)k}+B_{1k}\right)+4{\cal H}v_{1(\alpha)}^{k}\left(v_{1(\alpha)k}+B_{1k}\right)\right]
−4(ρ0​α+P0​α)C1​i​j′C1i​j+2(ρ0​α+P0​α)(2v1​αkϕ1,k+ϕ1∇2v1​α)\displaystyle-4\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)C_{1ij}^{\prime}C_{1}^{ij}+2\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)\left(2v_{1\alpha}^{k}{\phi_{{1}}}_{,k}+{\phi_{{1}}}\nabla^{2}v_{1\alpha}\right)
+2​π1​(α)​i​j​(C1′i​j−2​ℋ​C1i​j)+2​π1​(α)k​l​v1​(α)​k,l+2​v1​αk​π1​(α)​k​l,l\displaystyle+2\pi_{1(\alpha)ij}\left(C_{1}^{\prime ij}-2{\cal H}C_{1}^{ij}\right)+2\pi_{1(\alpha)}^{kl}v_{1(\alpha)k,l}+2v_{1\alpha}^{k}\pi_{1(\alpha)kl,}^{~~~l}
+2​(ρ0​α+P0​α)​(−3​ψ1,l+∇2E1,l)​v1​αl\displaystyle+2\left(\rho_{0\alpha}+P_{0\alpha}\right)\left(-3\psi_{1,l}+\nabla^{2}E_{1,l}\right)v_{1\alpha}^{l}
=a⁡{δ​Q2​α+2​ϕ1​δ​Q1​α+Q0​α​(ϕ2−ϕ12+v1​k​v1k)+4a​f1​(α)​k​v1k}.\displaystyle=a\Big\{\delta Q_{2\alpha}+2{\phi_{{1}}}\delta Q_{1\alpha}+Q_{0\alpha}\left({\phi_{{2}}}-{\phi_{{1}}}^{2}+v_{1k}v_{1}^{k}\right)+\frac{4}{a}f_{1(\alpha)k}v_{1}^{k}\Big\}\,. (4.76)

For a single fluid we find by summing over the individual fluids and using Eq. (4.22)

δ​ρ2′+3​ℋ​(δ​ρ2+δ​P2)+(ρ0+P0)​(−3​ψ2′+∇2E2′+∇2v2)\displaystyle\delta\rho_{2}^{\prime}+3{\cal H}\left({\delta\rho_{2}}+{\delta P_{2}}\right)+\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left(-3\psi_{2}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}E_{2}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}v_{2}\right)
+2(δρ1+δP1)(−3ψ1′+∇2E1′+∇2v1)+2(δρ1+δP1),kv1k+2(ρ0′+P0′)v1k(v1​k+B1​k)\displaystyle+2\left({\delta\rho_{1}}+{\delta P_{1}}\right)\left(-3\psi_{1}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}E_{1}^{\prime}+\nabla^{2}v_{1}\right)+2\left({\delta\rho_{1}}+{\delta P_{1}}\right)_{,k}v_{1}^{k}+2\left(\rho_{0}^{\prime}+P_{0}^{\prime}\right)v_{1}^{k}\left(v_{1k}+B_{1k}\right)
+2​(ρ0+P0)​[(v1​k′+B1​k′)​(2​v1​k+B1​k)+4​ℋ​v1k​(v1​k+B1​k)]−4​(ρ0+P0)​C1​i​j′​C1i​j\displaystyle+2\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left[\left(v_{1k}^{\prime}+B_{1k}^{\prime}\right)\left(2v_{1k}+B_{1k}\right)+4{\cal H}v_{1}^{k}\left(v_{1k}+B_{1k}\right)\right]-4\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)C_{1ij}^{\prime}C_{1}^{ij}
+2(ρ0+P0)(2v1kϕ1,k+ϕ1∇2v1)+2π1​i​j(C1′i​j−2ℋC1i​j)+2π1k​lv1​k,l+2v1kπ1​k​l,l\displaystyle+2\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left(2v_{1}^{k}{\phi_{{1}}}_{,k}+{\phi_{{1}}}\nabla^{2}v_{1}\right)+2\pi_{1ij}\left(C_{1}^{\prime ij}-2{\cal H}C_{1}^{ij}\right)+2\pi_{1}^{kl}v_{1k,l}+2v_{1}^{k}\pi_{1kl,}^{~~~l}
+2​(ρ0+P0)​(−3​ψ1,l+∇2E1,l)​v1l=0.\displaystyle+2\left(\rho_{0}+P_{0}\right)\left(-3\psi_{1,l}+\nabla^{2}E_{1,l}\right)v_{1}^{l}=0\,. (4.77)
